name: calc_integral_x_mul_sin_sq
statement: : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.pi, x * Real.sin x ^ 2 = Real.pi ^ 2 / 4
closed: ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..Real.pi, x * Real.sin x ^ 2 = Real.pi ^ 2 / 4
informal: ∫₀^π x sin²x dx = π²/4 — sin² = (1−cos 2x)/2, antiderivative x²/4 − x sin(2x)/4 − cos(2x)/8; or symmetry x ↦ π−x with integral_sin_sq.
